definitions.explanation: An opening in a wall for light and air.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}から{外|そと}を{見|み}る。
examples.english: To look outside through the window.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}を{閉|し}めてください。
{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}っているから、{窓|まど}を{閉|し}めた。
examples.english: It was raining, so I closed the window.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}{起|お}きたら、まず{窓|まど}を{開|あ}けて{新|あたら}しい{空気|くうき}を{入|い}れます。
examples.english: When I wake up in the morning, I first open the window to let in fresh air.

notes:
{窓|まど} refers to windows—openings in walls for light, air, and viewing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {窓|まど}を{開|あ}ける: to open a window
- {窓|まど}を{閉|し}める: to close a window
- {窓|まど}から{見|み}る: to look out the window
- {窓|まど}ガラス: window glass/pane

COMPOUNDS:
- {窓口|まどぐち}: service counter, point of contact
- {窓側|まどがわ}: window side (seats on trains)
- {窓辺|まどべ}: by the window
- {出窓|でまど}: bay window
- {窓枠|まどわく}: window frame

NOTE:
{窓口|まどぐち} is commonly used figuratively to mean "point of contact" or "service counter" (e.g., {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち} = consultation desk).
